extracted.intended_audience: general readers and math enthusiasts interested in the aesthetics and impact of mathematics
extracted.subtask_description: Identify and apply criteria that characterize when a body of mathematics (rather than a single proof) is 'beautiful', focusing on explanatory power, scope, simplicity, predictiveness, cross-disciplinary impact, and accessibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Universal applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Mathematics that explains phenomena across diverse fields demonstrates elegance through breadth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beautiful math explains 'the coexistence of selfishness and sympathy, competition and co-operation, war and peace' across domains; breadth of application to many situations is a mark of beauty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foundational power
rubrics_metrics.description: A body of mathematics that transforms how we understand whole domains, akin to Newton or Einstein for physics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nash's work is praised because it did for biological and social universes what Newton and Einstein did for the physical universe — i.e., it provides a transformative explanatory framework that reorganises understanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Elegant simplicity underlying complexity
rubrics_metrics.description: A simple, clear concept that resolves or organizes fabulously complex phenomena evidences beauty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Nash equilibrium is described as 'a special balancing point' that captures and resolves complex system behaviour; the aesthetic value lies in simplicity that accounts for complexity rather than brute-force solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Predictive precision
rubrics_metrics.description: Mathematics that reliably yields solutions or predictions for a wide range of scenarios, offering certainty amid uncertainty, is beautiful.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article emphasizes that solutions 'could always be found' for any scenario, and that this capability to produce definite answers contributes to the work's elegance and power.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-disciplinary resonance
rubrics_metrics.description: Mathematics whose ideas reverberate and revolutionise multiple disciplines exhibits beauty by transcending narrow domains.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beautiful math 'came to revolutionise' fields like military strategy, economics, evolutionary biology, psychology, and sociology — the capacity to influence and reframe diverse disciplines is a criterion of beauty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility without sacrifice
rubrics_metrics.description: Conveying rigorous concepts in a clear, engaging, and conversational style while preserving intellectual integrity contributes to beauty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article notes that rigorous ideas presented in 'a light and conversational style' enhance their appeal without diminishing depth; accessibility that does not sacrifice rigor is prized.
